# Game Idea: Orbit Escape

- Control a small ship on an HTML canvas, thrusting and rotating to dodge a constantly scrolling field of asteroids.
- Collect occasional fuel cells to extend your flight time and shield pickups to survive one hit.
- **Lose condition:** The ship collides with any asteroid or runs out of fuel.
- Simple physics and score based on distance traveled; easy to implement with canvas drawing and keyboard controls.
